items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Old man Ford. He used to play Kodgen.

ctx.x: He played little mandolin and ukulele and stuff like that. Punchy nosey.

I just forget this boy's name. He used to play Kodgen. What did he call it? Old man Ford. He used to play Kodgen. That was a band. They had a Kodgen, a Kodgen and a Washboard. And that was a band. And that was a band. Who played the Kodgen?
I don't know. Did he have a separate guy to do it? Or would Ford play it?
